subject.title: Add user chat bubble color selector for macOS application

question: Should this macOS color preference be accepted as a local app setting only, accepted as public OpenClawKit appearance API with an approved default migration, or replaced with a fresh narrower branch?
rationale: The remaining blockers include product/API scope and upgrade-default behavior, not just mechanical code cleanup.

options.title: Rebase and narrow before merge
options.body: Move Colors into the current sidebar/detail settings model, keep the preference store local unless explicitly approved, preserve the shipped unset default or add a tested migration, remove lockfile drift, and require current-head proof.

options.title: Accept broader API and default change
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally own the new public OpenClawKit appearance API and accent-color default, but should require API coverage, upgrade proof, and dependency provenance first.

options.title: Ask for a fresh focused branch
options.body: If rebasing this stale branch is too costly, pause this PR and ask for a current-main replacement that keeps the useful color UI without package churn.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Move Colors into the current sidebar/detail settings model, keep the preference store local unless explicitly approved, preserve the shipped unset default or add a tested migration, remove lockfile drift, and require current-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant current-main settings and chat UI architecture traces to Vincent Koc's recent commit 16865d58ca1f04ee52b625352aa9aa22f94d155f.
